entities.summary: Chineze Uzoamaka Nwagbo is a Nigerian-American who played on Syracuse University’s women's basketball team from 2000 - 2005, and played professional basketball internationally for a 11 years worldwide. Her most recent role was serving as the Director of Player Programs and Engagement with the National Football League Players Association.
